name: Wave-collapse town builder (3D)
oneLiner: A cosy three.js town builder on a grid: click a cell to raise it (sea, land, a house, more storeys) and wave function collapse resolves every wall, door, window, balcony, lane, gable / hip / terrace / turret roof, stair and gate arch from its neighbours by socket rules, re-solving only around the edit. Orbit camera, hover ghost, pop and dust on each edit, exact undo / redo, four palettes, soft shadows, gulls; an exhaustive verifier proves no broken adjacency anywhere.
fits: city or village editors inside a bigger game
procedural settlements from a height map
puzzle goals about shaping a town (arches, towers, stairs)
notFor: simulation builders with economy, citizens and roads as agents
voxel worlds with digging and caves
devices without WebGL as the main target (a 2D map is shown)

needs: three.js 0.149.0 (window.THREE, three.min.js next to the page)
a WebGL canvas (and optionally a 2D canvas on top for the HUD)
a start map: rows of digits (0 sea, 1 land, 2+ a house with 1+ storeys)
a fixed-step update (60 Hz) and a draw pass
pointer or key input that calls grow / shrink / undo / redo
provides: rules: a socket table (sea, grass, lane, stair, joined wall, window wall, door, balcony, stair wall, arch, eave, ridge, gable end, parapet, turret) and a wave-function-collapse solver (AC-3 propagation, weighted lowest-entropy collapse, local re-solve radius 2 with widening, guaranteed fallback)
edits: grow, shrink, set, undo / redo restoring exact snapshots, load; deterministic from the seed and the edit history
verification: verify() over every side, top and bottom of every slot; counts() (houses, storeys, doors, arches, stairs, roofs...)

the screen: code-built low-poly houses and roofs, island slabs with foam and rocks, lanes, trees, wells, lamps, sea and sky, one soft-shadowed sun, four palettes (one lit at dusk), gulls that face their flight
camera: orbit, pitch, zoom with easing; picking of columns; hover ghost; anchors in screen px; screen-direction to grid-direction mapping
extension: registerTile (slot, sockets, weight, build with a small geometry API), registerPair, allowAir, setWeight

assets: none: houses, roofs, arches, stairs, islands, trees, lamps, sea, sky, gulls and HUD are drawn by code; three.js 0.149.0 (MIT) is the only dependency (vendor/three@0.149.0/three.min.js, copied next to the page as three.min.js)

facing.facingOffset: -PI/2 (gulls are modelled beak on +X); no walking characters

checks: checks/render-checks.py (ground seams by ray test, clipped-white blobs over a full turn per palette; 2 mutants)
